sloka: श्वसनेन च संयोगादतिवेगो महाबलः ।कालाग्निरिव जज्वाल प्रावर्धत हुताशनः ।। 5.54.21 ।।।।
transliteration: śvasanena ca saṁyogādativego mahābalaḥ ।kālāgniriva jajvāla prāvardhata hutāśanaḥ ।। 5.54.21 ।।।।

translations.english: The windgod's association made the fire spread at great speed. It appeared like fire at the time of dissolution.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर मैंने नागमाता सुरसा को देखा | समुद्र में खड़ी हुई सुरसा, मुझसे वे वचन बोली
